{{Quote|A Kazellis. That's a rare bird&mdash;they stopped making those years ago. We have an ID yet?''"<br />"''Yes, sir. Code response confirms it's the ''Salaban's Hope''.|Captain Calo Drusan and the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Communications officer/Legends|comm officer]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The '''''Salaban's Hope''''' was a [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] owned by the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. It shared its name with the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Salaban]], and was produced by the [[Kazellis Corporation]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. That year, Esva and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], "[[Sorro]]," used the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] to rendezvous with the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Several [[Starship/Legends|starships]] [[Skirmish against Nuso Esva's forces|attacked]] the ''Salaban's Hope''; however, the ''Chimaera'' and the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used their combined [[Laser cannon/Legends|firepower]] to destroy all but two of the attackers, which escaped.

The freighter [[Hangar/Legends|docked]] with the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] before visiting an unknown [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva's commanders)|world]], where Esva met with his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]], and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. After returning to the ''Chimaera'', Esva had the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] travel to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], where his [[Eastern Fleet]] [[Battle of the Poln system|engaged]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces present. While the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet destroyed his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the warlord fled aboard the ''Salaban's Hope''.

==Description==
{{Quote|In the meantime, may I request you shunt all other available power to the tractor beams and pull&mdash;''"<br />"''Not a good idea, my lord. At this range, a full-power tractor beam could severely damage your hull. And if we breach&mdash;|Warlord Nuso Esva and Captain Calo Drusan|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]], the ''Salaban's Hope''<ref name="Choices" /> measured at twenty-eight [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="SS" /> and was equipped with [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Choices" /> An [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer's]]<ref name="HTTES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> full-power<ref name="Choices" /> [[Q7 tractor beam projector/Legends|Q7 tractor beam]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|technology|tractorbeam|tractor beam}}</ref> could significantly damage the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. The ''Salaban's Hope'' was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and [[Weapon/Legends|armed]] with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] possessed a [[Hangar/Legends|docking hatch]].<ref name="Choices" />

==History==
===Raiders and visits===
{{Quote|Commander Pellaeon's report said that after Nuso Esva came aboard the ''Chimaera'' he made a short visit to a planet called Wroona.''"<br />"''Plus a longer one to a place they still haven't identified. Yes, I read the report.''"<br />"''The unknown world is of no lasting importance. That would have been the place Nuso Esva chose to meet with his commanders and finalize his plans for the operation.|Senior Captain Thrawn and Jorj Car'das|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:TheClaw.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Salaban's Hope'' was a Kazellis-class light freighter (pictured) produced by the Kazellis Corporation.]]
Produced by the [[Kazellis Corporation]]<ref name="SS" /> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Commission" /> the ''Salaban's Hope'' was a freighter that shared its name with the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Salaban]].<ref name="Choices" /> The [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], who ruled a [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]], owned the freighter.<ref name="Choices" /> In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the warlord and his [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], "[[Sorro]]," used the ''Salaban's Hope'' to rendezvous with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]]<ref name="Choices" /> ''Imperial II''-class [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]<ref name="HTTES" /> [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Upon arriving at the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] location, the light freighter was [[Skirmish against Nuso Esva's forces|attacked]] by six [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of Esva's realm. Assuming the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo, the warlord had the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Calo Drusan]], pull the two endmost attackers toward his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] while the ''Salaban's Hope'' destroyed them and some of the others.<ref name="Choices" />

While most of the raiders were destroyed and two escaped, Sorro landed Esva's light freighter in the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} hangar. After Esva donned a mask and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] to conceal his identity and his pilot introduced themselves to Imperial Commander [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], they traveled to their [[Nuso Esva's quarters|quarters]] near the ''Salaban's Hope'' and the hangar. Shortly afterward, Esva brought the ''Salaban's Hope'' to an unknown [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva's commanders)|world]], where he met with his commanders, and the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]], where he acquired [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and equipment that he planned to use to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the ''Chimaera''. After returning to the Star Destroyer, he requested quarters closer to the warship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], as he no longer needed quick access to his Kazellis.<ref name="Choices" />

===Nuso Esva's escape===
{{Quote|Nuso Esva. Or at least, a freighter that shouldn't be out there. Backtrack says it came from the ''Chimaera''. It has to be him. I may still be able to hit him from here.|Jorj Car'das, to Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Jorj.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jorj Car'das (pictured) contemplated the possibility of destroying the ''Salaban's Hope''.]]
Shortly afterward, the ''Chimaera'' traveled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] alongside Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']]&mdash;which was [[Flagship/Legends|led]] by the<ref name="Choices" /> ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref> ''[[Admonitor]]''&mdash;and the senior captain's [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] ''[[Lost Reef]]''. Esva destroyed the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engines]] with his thermal detonators and set the vessel on a collision course with a nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], summoning his [[Eastern Fleet]] and commanding it to [[Battle of the Poln system|destroy]] the ''Admonitor'' and the ''Chimaera''. Esva left the sabotaged Star Destroyer aboard the ''Salaban's Hope''.<ref name="Choices" />

[[Jorj Car'das]], the ''Lost Reef''{{'s}} pilot, watched as Esva escaped and contemplated the possibility of destroying the warlord's freighter and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Storm-hair; however, under Thrawn's directive, Car'das focused on using the ''Lost Reef''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to move the ''Chimaera'' away from its collision course. After the Deepwater freighter moved the Imperial warship away from its collision course, the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet arrived, destroying the Eastern Fleet while Esva fled the battle aboard the ''Salaban's Hope''.<ref name="Choices" />

==Owners and operators==
Warlord Nuso Esva, the owner of the ''Salaban's Hope'', tasked a Human known as Sorro with piloting the Kazellis.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Salaban's Hope'' appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
